gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-amulya: Wallpoet lands hard, its tall lowercase and see-through lines feeling bold. Amulya follows in a modern sans with generous curve gaps, so a longer read stays light and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-chillax: Chillax reads loose and casual, like spaghetti spelled out in letters. Give it a comfortable size under Wallpoet, whose smooth, high-rising lowercase stays bold and commanding up top.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-plein: Commanding in the heading and reliable below, the pair puts Wallpoet's tall lowercase over Plein's moderate one. Wallpoet is best at making an entrance; Plein is best at staying clear.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-roundo: Roundo reads geometric and unfussy, its n built with arch and stem in step and small counters kept open. And Wallpoet, with its high lowercase and see-through lines, gives that plain sans a loud, confident partner.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads approachable and modern, its strokes drawn as if with a compass pencil. Wallpoet brings the bold, commanding punch up top, and that gap in temperament is the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, clean and dependable. Wallpoet does best at being bold and commanding with its high lowercase, while Synonym does best at keeping its open curves quietly readable.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-aclonica: Wallpoet's high-rising lowercase and the paper showing through its lines give it a commanding, stencil-like punch. Aclonica below, wide and deep-bodied with slightly lighter joins, keeps a longer read steady.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-allerta: Wallpoet comes in bold and commanding, with smooth bends and lowercase that rises high. Allerta then spreads out beneath it, loosely tracked with a prominent x-height, so the heavy heading has room to breathe.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-alumni-sans: Alumni Sans is clean and approachable, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height and its wide c like a bracelet pulled apart. Wallpoet's high, bold lowercase is the loud counterpoint.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Alumni Sans Pinstripe packs a tight word texture, with oversized lowercase beside small capitals. Alumni Sans Pinstripe would look lost if the Wallpoet heading went small, since that bold, commanding voice needs size to land.
